releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.2.4

- OBLIVION CASE now spins a full reel like the other cases, with ??? tiles flying past for suspense.
- LEADERBOARD PROFILES: click any player to see their stats and showcase axe, and jump straight to a trade with them.
- SHOWCASE AXE: pick any axe you own to show off on your profile and leaderboard row.
- PRESTIGE now counts on the leaderboard: the Prestige / Rebirths tab ranks prestige first.
- Leaderboard standings now refresh every 5-25 minutes. Trade offers are checked every 5 minutes and whenever you open the Trading tab.
- Heads up: Tree App Store coming soon!
